title: Separated and locally quasi-finite morphisms are stable under base change (Stacks 01KU, 01TM)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:S'\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f':X'=X\times_SS'\to S'$ the base change [def-pc-fibre-product]. (1) If $f$ is separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], then $f'$ is separated. (2) If $f$ is locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], then $f'$ is locally quasi-finite.
